caption: A pigeon flies straight at a closed window, hits the glass with a thump, bounces off and drops to the ground below.

sa.check: A pigeon flies straight at a closed window.
It drops to the ground below.
The hit comes first, then the bounce, then the drop.

pc.expect: The pigeon stops at the pane, the glass stays whole, and nothing passes through.
pc.fail: It passes through the glass; or the glass shatters and lets it through; or the bird sinks into the glass.

pc.expect: It is thrown back at the instant of impact, slower than it came.
pc.fail: It is thrown back before contact; or keeps going forward; or leaves faster.

pc.expect: It falls after the bounce and lands.
pc.fail: It hovers; or rises after the bounce; or floats.

pc.expect: Its wings and body stay attached.
pc.fail: A wing detaches; or the body morphs; or two birds appear.

pc.expect: One pigeon and one window keep their number.
pc.fail: The bird splits; or the window duplicates; or the bird merges with the glass.

pc.expect: The plumage and the window frame stay the same.
pc.fail: The plumage changes; or the frame changes; or the wall rearranges.

note: The pigeon is self-driven: its flight is its own. Only the impact and what follows are judged.
